scope: Reviewed AI contributions to molecular design, target selection, repurposing, recruitment and trial analysis. Non-design cases are limited to explicitly verified registry IDs; overlapping roles do not duplicate trial counts.

programs.name: Rentosertib
programs.ai_role: Chemistry42 generated and optimized TNIK-inhibitor structures; PandaOmics also prioritized the target.

programs.name: Garutadustat
programs.ai_role: Chemistry42 generated and optimized a gut-restricted PHD1/2 inhibitor, including scaffold design and predicted pharmacological properties.

programs.name: REC-617
programs.ai_role: The developer reports generative AI and active learning for molecular design, binding selectivity and ADME/PK optimization of a CDK7 inhibitor.

programs.name: XL309
programs.ai_role: The developer attributes generation of this USP1-inhibitor structure to Chemistry42.

programs.name: EXS21546
programs.ai_role: The developer describes an A2A receptor antagonist whose molecular structure was designed with its AI platform.

programs.name: Baricitinib (COVID-19)
programs.sponsor: Eli Lilly / NIAID / University of Oxford
programs.ai_role: BenevolentAI used a biomedical knowledge graph with machine-learning-extracted relationships to nominate the existing arthritis drug baricitinib for COVID-19. This is AI-assisted repurposing, not AI design of the molecule. Coverage is limited to the named COVID-19 trials.
programs.evidence_type: Original AI-repurposing report and clinical trial publications

evidence.title: COV-BARRIER trial results (Lancet Respiratory Medicine; NCT04421027)

NCT04381936.ai_role: Only the baricitinib COVID-19 comparison is in scope; other RECOVERY treatment arms are not attributed to AI.
NCT04381936.scope_note: The registry describes the multi-treatment RECOVERY platform. The baricitinib comparison enrolled February 2–December 29, 2021; platform start and current recruitment status are not baricitinib-specific.

programs.name: BEN-8744
programs.indication: Ulcerative colitis; first-in-human study in healthy volunteers
programs.ai_role: BenevolentAI reports that its platform identified PDE10 inhibition as a new target hypothesis for ulcerative colitis. Scientists validated the hypothesis ex vivo and developed BEN-8744. The category records the documented target-selection role.

evidence.title: BEN-8744 target-selection role and Phase Ia results

programs.name: Resmetirom
programs.ai_role: HistoIndex qFibrosis and PathAI AIM-NASH measured liver-biopsy responses in secondary or exploratory analyses of MAESTRO-NASH. The original primary endpoint readings were by central pathologists.
programs.timing_note: AI re-reading of trial biopsies was reported after the original topline results. Evidence does not establish that AI determined primary endpoints or drove trial conduct. Use the AI-analysis disclosure date for AI coverage counts, not the trial start.
programs.evidence_type: Sponsor disclosure and investigator conference abstract

supporting_sources.supports: Links NCT03900429 to AI slide-reading exploratory endpoint and 768 paired biopsies.
qFibrosis described as a secondary analysis of MAESTRO-NASH biopsies.

programs.name: Pemvidutide
programs.ai_role: PathAI Liver Explore quantified fibrosis in a supplemental blinded analysis of IMPACT liver biopsies. Conventional pathologist readings assessed the primary biopsy endpoints.
programs.timing_note: The sponsor described a blinded supplemental AI analysis reported alongside 24-week results. Pre-specification of this AI analysis was not established; do not label it a prospective AI primary endpoint.
programs.evidence_type: Sponsor SEC filing and trial presentation

supporting_sources.supports: Slide 6 contrasts primary pathologist reads with supplemental blinded AI; slide 11 identifies PathAI Liver Explore.
Names Liver Explore and links analysis explicitly to IMPACT NCT05989711.
